newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police arrest six for Corsican bombings.
newsitem.headline: French police arrest six for Corsican bombings.

text.p: French police arrested six people in Corsica on Thursday in connection with a weekend blitz of bombings by separatist guerrillas on the French Mediterranean island.

Police said that among those held in Bastia and Ghisonaccia were employees of a security firm owned by a leader of Cuncolta Naziunalista, the legal wing of the outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC).
The FLNC exploded 76 small devices in Corsica on Sunday in a show of strength responding to a police crackdown in recent weeks.
Three of the Cuncolta's main political leaders are in detention.

No one was injured in Sunday's coordinated pre-dawn blitz of small blasts. Damage was mostly limited to smashed windows or damaged doorways at post offices, tax offices and other symbols of French state authority in towns and villages.
